items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I knew him when he was taking piano lessons through a friend of my mother's and I called her Aunt Thelma

ctx.x: Yes. I got to know him very well. But I knew Ben in Kansas City, but I didn't know his worth at that time. See I knew him when he was taking piano lessons through a friend of my mother's and I called her Aunt Thelma but Ben studied piano in Kansas City.
What was Aunt Thelma's last name?
